split.behavior: one representative per exact URL, then URL-disjoint split

permissions.query_labels: terminal metrics, candidate oracle and retrospective frontier analysis only; never adaptation or deployed threshold selection
permissions.url_hostname: split grouping and posthoc clustering metrics only
permissions.source_valid_labels: per-candidate output threshold calibration only; not gradient/selection; observed model-selection valid
permissions.query_input: fixed per-sample model+source-neighbor inference; no optimizer or fitted query statistics except explicitly transductive standard tent_bn

adaptation.sample_distribution: degenerate Gaussian N(embedding,0); diagonal Gaussian W2 squared / dimension
adaptation.soft_assignment: frozen teacher predicted class; mixture prior times exp(-W2/source median nearest W2)
adaptation.routing: actual v4 rules are exclusively routing_v4; not the legacy GMM route
adaptation.distance: minimum over all classes and components of mean squared standardized Mahalanobis
adaptation.routing_fit: frozen source geometry plus unlabeled reference entropy quantiles
adaptation.target_update: fixed q within frozen top5; q detached; hard teacher onehot or soft teacher T2 or teacher T2 times source kNN votes
adaptation.acceptance_calibration: source validation: minimum bank log-vote gain threshold over frozen classifier; smallest feasible grid value with >=10 changes, correction:damage>=2 and damage<=1% of baseline correct; fallback reject all
adaptation.neighbor_banks: source rows hash parity; two deterministic disjoint banks
adaptation.tent_protocol: 400x64 reference entropy updates; two query policies: standard batch-stat transductive, and sequential reference-population BN calibration without query statistics

routing_v4.geometry: frozen standardized feature cosine distances to 102 source means; PMR=(d2-d1)/(d2+1e-8)
routing_v4.normalization: batch mean w*per_sample_KL and w*pull; weighted relational loss multiplied by mean(w); source identity unchanged
routing_v4.weight_shuffle: conditional extra 30 tasks only if C or D raw recovery at diagnostic NAR<=1% improves >=0.5pp over ungated, positive all3seeds; matched best eligible soft arm, geometry preferred on tie; retain hist by deterministic batch permutation

acceptance_v4.primary_score: sigmoid(frozen candidate-class geometric margin/0.05)*sigmoid(same-class normalized logit margin gain/0.05)*exp(-frozen_maha/source_valid_maha_median); maha>source_valid99 => score=-1
acceptance_v4.normalized_logit_margin: logit/sqrt(mean(logit**2)+1e-12); candidate vs max other class; gain before to after for same candidate
acceptance_v4.selection: source-valid maximize recovery count subject NAR budget, >=10 changes and positive net corrections; tie fewer damages then higher threshold; fallback reject all
acceptance_v4.retrospective_frontier: all unique-score prefixes, ties indivisible; maximum recovery under NAR<=1%/2%; posthoc only, never deployment
acceptance_v4.random: analytic expected random acceptance line; all changed predictions uniformly eligible
acceptance_v4.primary: D minus ungated recovery@NAR1 >=0.5pp, positive in all3 seeds, at least2/3 factors positive and remaining factor >=-0.5pp; diagnostic signal only
acceptance_v4.secondary: C/B matched comparisons, 2% budget, same-recovery minimum NAR, against matched TENT/direct; source calibrated output separately
